subject: Request to pause demo timer during purchasing approval
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@veridianhealth.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Donna Kelly <donna.kelly@veridianhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Purchasing hold — can you pause the demo timer?

Hi Connor,

Quick heads up from our side — procurement is reviewing the SOW and our vendor onboarding for about a week longer than expected. Finance (cc'd) needs an internal approval loop before the PO clears.

We'd really like to keep the sandbox and the integrations live so our engineers can keep validating the EHR flow. Is there a way to "freeze" the demo timer or get a short-term token/top-up so the environment doesn't expire while procurement completes its review? Even 5–7 days would be enough to avoid losing momentum.

I attached the email thread from our procurement contact so you can see where we are ("purchase-approval-stub.pdf"). If there's any paperwork you need from us to make this happen, let me know.

Thanks — appreciate it.

Samir
Senior Product Manager
Veridian Health

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: Donna Kelly <donna.kelly@veridianhealth.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Purchasing hold — can you pause the demo timer?

Hi Samir — thanks for the update and for sharing the procurement thread. Sorry for the hassle. We can do one of two things quickly to keep the demo usable while your PO clears:

- Option A: Freeze the onboarding/demo timer for 7 days (no additional credits, environment stays live).
- Option B: Add a temporary credit of 7,500 tokens to the account so your team can continue running evals and integrations while procurement finalizes the PO.

I'll need a quick internal approval for Option B (credits) — Option A I can enable from my side as a temporary measure. If you prefer credits, send a short note confirming and I'll route for manager sign-off.

If Option A works, I can apply it now and send a confirmation. Which do you prefer?

Connor O'Brien
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
(415) 555-0142

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 11:08:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Purchasing hold — can you pause the demo timer?

Laura / Camila — forwarding Samir's note from Veridian Health (DEAL-VER-1427). They hit a procurement review that will likely take another week.

Request: can we either (1) freeze the demo timer for 7 days (quick, low-risk), or (2) authorize a temporary 7,500-token credit against the deal while the PO clears? They attached the procurement email (purchase-approval-stub.pdf) showing the review status.

Context: Veridian is mid-PoC, engineering is actively testing EHR integration; losing the sandbox would materially slow the deal. If we grant credits, I'd like to tie it to a simple one-page acknowledgement (we can send trial-extension-agreement.pdf) and record in the deal notes.

Can you confirm approval and the preferred mechanism? I can enable Option A immediately if you want to avoid extra steps.

—Connor

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 14:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Purchasing hold — can you pause the demo timer?

Connor — thanks for flagging. Approve Option A (freeze demo timer for 7 days) immediately so Veridian doesn't lose momentum.

If the customer explicitly asks for credits instead of the freeze, approve up to 7,500 tokens provided we document it in the deal record and get a brief email from their procurement acknowledging the timeframe. Request that Connor attach the trial-extension-agreement.pdf to the CRM record.

Make it operational now and confirm when done.

Laura Bennett
Director, Sales — MidMarket
Redwood Inference

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@veridianhealth.com>, Donna Kelly <donna.kelly@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Purchasing hold — can you pause the demo timer?

Hi Samir / Donna — quick update: Laura approved a 7-day freeze of your sandbox/demo environment to keep everything live while procurement completes review. We've applied the freeze starting now; your sandbox will not expire for the next 7 days (no additional action required on your side).

If you want the temporary 7,500-token credit instead, reply to this thread confirming and we will issue it with the simple acknowledgment attached (trial-extension-agreement.pdf). Once we have that from procurement, we will mark the credit in our CRM and adjust the deal record: https://app.redwood.com/deals/DEAL-VER-1427

Attachment: trial-extension-agreement.pdf (simple one-page acknowledgement; please sign or confirm by reply if you take the credit option).

I'll check back in three days to see how procurement is progressing — happy to extend further if needed and approved.

Thanks — Connor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
